postfit.interpretation: Room/temperature confounded. Family resampling conditional on observed rooms, no independent temperature replication. Duration/mass conditional on survival and paired measurement. Survival uses observed flags; five absent source records are all in 12-day cold limited cell, source-planned-slot bounds do not impute their outcomes. Nominal delay correction does not identify actual calendar phase.

provenance.extraction: Exact aggregate JSON from completed calculation; ZIP checksum from upload log; ZIP not independently downloaded. Source MD5 and SHA256 reverified; all mode/endpoint delay contrasts independently recomputed from returned cell means.
